Theorem
[Main theorem] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0118, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0119 1. Theorem 5.1\group main-theorem

If $(\mathcal{M}^2,g_0)$ is a closed Riemannian surface, there exists a unique solution $g(t)$ of the normalized Ricci flow \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}g=(r-R)g,\qquad g(0)=g_0, \] which exists for all time and converges uniformly in any $C^k$-norm to a smooth metric $g_\infty $ of constant curvature.
